<thought>Based on the observed isotopic distribution (M, M+1 ≈11 % of M, M+2 ≈1 % of M, rapidly decreasing thereafter), the pattern matches the natural 13C abundance for a molecule containing roughly 10 C atoms. No other element shows a characteristic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
